body:
A wonderful 4-wheeled movement device used for all your moving needs. Warning: may experience explosions.


The Trolley is an object that can be purchased from Jerry's Junk for $1400. It allows players to move a small amount of cargo.

Details

The Trolley is effectively a human-powered version of the Basic Flatbed Trailer. Objects can be placed on top of the Trolley, and they will attach to it, allowing the player to move multiple objects at once. If it tips over, it will immediately dump all of its cargo onto the ground.

The Trolley cannot be grabbed by any grabbers.

Trivia

  • Prior to the map revamp, the Trolley was sold at Jer's Junkyard.
  • The original price of the Trolley was $280 until it was removed. The developers said: "Trolley will return to the Junkyard soon! Removed it temporarily until it fully works properly." Trolleys returned in update 1.28.0 for a price of $680, although this price was soon changed to $1,400 in update 1.28.1.
  • We're still not sure if it explodes.
